mechanisms.trigger: member first tool, direction registration and duplicate check
mechanisms.basis: tool loop enforces direction ownership; similarity judgment is model-based
mechanisms.local: research_cycle.py / task_context.py / run_bounded.py: study records and selected task binding, no always-on swarm
mechanisms.decision: reuse decision records; continuous swarm gating would require new infrastructure, unnecessary here

mechanisms.basis: coordinator model decides feedback, acceptance and optional finish
mechanisms.decision: retain separate calculation, interpretation and independent review; coordinator verdict does not establish scientific validity

mechanisms.trigger: register target and choose next branch
mechanisms.basis: discovery registers a fixed Lean target; search policy consumes typed diagnostics and budgets
mechanisms.local: plan_seal, check_research_flow and check_research_relations bind local obligations, stages and information uses
mechanisms.decision: add on-demand paired control checks where single-run checks lack cross-run information; no generic branch-scoring oracle

mechanisms.basis: formal type, axioms and frozen statement checked in a Lean environment
mechanisms.local: local comparison and recomputation check only specified numerical/structural properties
mechanisms.decision: not compatible as a general empirical verdict

mechanisms.basis: persisted board, pending verdicts and member transcripts; incomplete tool result unknown
mechanisms.local: task context, existing artifacts, run receipts and recovery review
mechanisms.decision: reuse scoped reinspection; new scheduler and process lifecycle needed for automatic restart, outside this change

validation_scope: synthetic two-table regression and package checks; no model performance, empirical effect, reader or external runtime trial
